description: Create a wiki in this workspace: a tree of pages your team reads in Kythene. `name` is what people call it; `slug` is its segment in a page address (derived from the name if you omit it). Set `approval_required` when a page must be approved before it goes live. `root_body` is the markdown of the wiki's home page - it starts as a DRAFT, like every page, so publish it with set_page_state before anyone can read it. The response `url` is the wiki's canonical link; hand that to a person rather than the id.

approvalRequired.description: approval_required makes every publish need an approval first.

description.description:
description is one line on what the wiki holds. It is what someone reads in
 list_wikis when they are choosing between several.

name.description: name is what people call it.

rootBody.description:
root_body is the markdown of the wiki's root page. It starts as a DRAFT, so
 publish it before anyone can read it.

slug.description: slug is its segment in a page URL; derived from the name when omitted.

space.description:
space optionally selects which of your workspaces to act in (an id or name
 from list_spaces). Omit it when you belong to a single workspace.

name: create_wiki

url.description: url is the wiki's canonical link - hand THAT to a person, not the id.

approvalRequired.description:
approval_required is true when a page in this wiki needs an approval before
 it goes live.

description.description: description is one line on what the wiki holds.

lastPublished.description:
last_published is when anything in it last went live (YYYY-MM-DD), empty if
 nothing has.

pages.description:
pages is how many pages you can see in it, and published is how many of
 those readers can see - together, whether the wiki is alive.

rootPage.description: root_page is the id of the wiki's root page.

slug.description: slug is the wiki's segment in a page URL.

title: Create wiki
